file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Anglia Ruskin University MBChB Medicine A100. ARU.docx is the authoritative implementation specification and replaces the Markdown research file referenced in the master prompt.

manual_review_scope: resit applicants where first-sitting evidence is incomplete
country-specific international qualifications, because international applicants are not eligible
research_scope.notes: ARU is implemented as an academic threshold plus SJT gate plus UCAT-ranking model. WAMS may stack with one regional percentage UCAT uplift. Essex takes precedence over East of England; no flat regional points are used.

evidence_classification_policy.OFFICIAL: Stated directly by ARU, MSC, UCAS or official ARU admissions-policy/course material referenced in ARU.docx.
evidence_classification_policy.FOI: Freedom of Information or historical admissions statistics referenced in ARU.docx. Used only for guidance and historical context.
evidence_classification_policy.AUTHORITATIVE_SPEC: The user-supplied ARU.docx implementation specification for this task.
evidence_classification_policy.ESTIMATE: ApplySmart labelled guidance or derived interpretation. Not an official ARU threshold or interview guarantee unless explicitly documented.
evidence_classification_policy.UNAVAILABLE: A source or value identified as missing or unsuitable for deterministic execution.

route_limited_blockers: IB and Scottish qualification execution is kept as manual-review because the supplied implementation scope is strongest for A-level threshold automation.
Applicant-specific resit first-sitting evidence may need manual review.
Offer prediction, MMI prediction and waiting-list prediction are permanently out of ApplySmart scope.
engine_execution_boundaries: Home A-level applicants can be checked for GCSE, A-level, UCAT presence and SJT Band 1-3.
International applicants are deterministically not eligible.
East of England UCAT uplift is 2.5%.
WAMS may stack with the single applicable regional uplift.
Essex receives the Essex regional uplift instead of also receiving the East of England uplift.
No flat regional point values are used.
Graduates apply through the same A100 process and remain in the same applicant pool.
Care-experienced/Care Leaver and Free School Meals guaranteed interviews apply only when academic and SJT conditions are met.
Final offers are based solely on MMI ranking, but offer prediction remains out of ApplySmart scope.
readiness.summary: Official/source-supplied evidence supports production activation for ARU A100 interview guidance within the supported Home A-level scope.

steps: Check Home fee status and academic minimums.
Apply WAMS plus the single applicable regional UCAT percentage uplift where documented.
Rank for interview by adjusted UCAT cognitive score.
Apply documented guaranteed-interview override for Care-experienced/Care Leaver or Free School Meals applicants only after academic and SJT conditions pass.

remaining_evidence_gaps.description: IB, Scottish and other equivalency routes are documented but not fully encoded for automatic execution in this activation.
Working UCAT thresholds and historical values are used as guidance; they are not fixed eligibility cut-offs.
